description: Shows the note name, octave and cents offset of every channel of a polyphonic pitch cable, and can round those pitches to the nearest semitone

params.text: Rounds every channel to the nearest semitone, at the display and at the output alike

inputs.text: The pitch voltages to be read, one channel per note

outputs.text: Carries the input pitches, rounded to semitones while the chromatic switch is on and untouched while it is off

notes: the display shows a note name, an octave number and, where the pitch is off the note by a hundredth of a semitone or more, the cents it is out by
voltages are read between -10V and 10V; anything further out is pulled back to that before the note is worked out
the display is refreshed every hundredth audio frame rather than every sample
